text:
lena: Photo drop — Poppy found an abandoned delivery box in the kitchen and immediately declared it the office CEO suite. posted pic: https://i.imgur.com/poppybox.jpg :brown_heart:

marcus: That head tilt is pure executive presence. Is she signing the Q3 roadmap with her paw? :laughing:

tara: She's using sticky notes as a mattress. someone update the budget for "premium cardboard insulation". :memo:

milo: Official notice: box is now labeled "Reserved by Poppy". Do not disturb unless you bring socks (preferred) or squeaky bribes. :socks:

giphy: GIF: tiny dog in box (posted)

lena: Confirmed: negotiations only accepted via ear scritches and the ceremonial rubber chicken. :dog:

marcus: Quick poll: should we install a permanent "Poppy Box" in the lounge? react :white_check_mark: for yes, :eyes: to veto.

tara: :white_check_mark: yes please

milo: :white_check_mark: bringing socks as tribute at 12:30.

lena: Also heads up: Poppy refuses to leave the meeting room during sprint planning. fetch-room-2 is now her throne. (reacts: :heart: from marcus, :tada: from tara)
